descriptor.scene: Gary and Maya stand together at full length, small against the bare end wall of the museum hall, having arrived at the last thing in it: the plain honey-brown door, unframed, unlit by any spotlight, standing open a little with warm golden light spilling through the gap onto the floor toward them. No rope, no plaque, no frame. Behind them, far back down the hall, the framed exhibited doors glow in their little pools of light. The end wall is otherwise completely bare. Keep the bottom right calm. The door leaf has EXACTLY FOUR recessed panels in TWO rows and no more: a top row of two small square panels, and below it a single row of two tall rectangular panels that reach nearly to the floor with only a plain flat rail beneath them. There is NO third row of panels at the bottom of the door.
negatives: any frame, plaque, rope or spotlight on or near the end-wall door
anything visible through the gap other than warm light
a six-panel colonial door, a third row of panels at the bottom of the door leaf
descriptor._caption: At the end of the hall there is no frame, no rope, no spotlight. There is a wall. In the wall there is a door, and the door is open.
